# HomeAdvisor

> HomeAdvisor connects homeowners with vetted contractors for home improvement and maintenance projects through a streamlined matching and service request platform.

HomeAdvisor operates a two-sided marketplace that serves both homeowners seeking home services and professional contractors looking for lead generation opportunities. The platform provides tools, resources, and guidance to facilitate successful home improvement projects and business growth.

## Key Topics

- HomeAdvisor Platform
- Contractor Matching
- Lead Generation
- Home Improvement Services
- Service Request Process
- Pro Services
- Homeowner Connections
- Contractor Reviews
- Business Growth
- True Cost Guide
- HomeAdvisor App
- Success Stories

## Platform Overview & Getting Started

- [How Does HomeAdvisor Work](https://hapro.homeadvisor.com/how-it-works/): Guide explaining HomeAdvisor's platform process for scheduling home care and maintenance projects.
- [HomeAdvisor Contractor Reviews - Pro Success Stories](http://www.pro.homeadvisor.com/): HomeAdvisor's contractor platform for lead generation and homeowner connections.
